name: PayPal Holdings, Inc.
blurb: PayPal operates one of the world's largest digital payments networks, facilitating transactions between consumers and merchants via its PayPal wallet, Venmo peer-to-peer app, Braintree payment gateway, and Honey shopping tool. Spun off from eBay in 2015, PayPal was for years one of the fastest-growing fintech companies globally; it has since faced intensified competition from Apple Pay, Google Pay, Stripe, and bank-issued digital wallets, compressing both growth and margins.
recent: PayPal has been undergoing a strategic overhaul under CEO Alex Chriss, who took the helm in 2023, focusing on profitable growth over transaction volume. The company has invested in AI-driven checkout personalisation and advertising capabilities. Despite a recovery in the stock price from multi-year lows, PayPal trades at a significant discount to its 2021 peak. Paul Pelosi sold 5,000 shares of PYPL per the January 2026 PTR disclosure.
